actions.text: Pressing the search button ("Search N Folder(s)") starts looking up all folders not yet searched; it appears only when unsearched items exist and no lookup is running.
Pressing Stop (shown while lookups are queued) cancels processing and clears the lookup queue.
Pressing the Import button imports the selected importable folders as series via a POST to the series import endpoint.
"Apply to selected" copies the default language, monitor, quality profile, season folder and series type onto every importable selected item.
The select-all checkbox selects all ready items and one chosen item per duplicate group, or clears the selection when unchecked.
The Metadata Settings button opens a modal to choose and save the preferred metadata language.
Users can search for and pick a different series match for a folder; picking one sets it as the selected series and, if its type is not standard, sets the series type to it.
Search results can be navigated with Arrow keys, chosen with Enter and dismissed with Escape.
The Compact Rows checkbox toggles compact rows.

rules.text: An item is 'existing' if its matched TVDB id is already in the library, 'duplicate' if another folder matched the same TVDB id, 'ready' if matched and unique, otherwise 'unmatched'.
Only ready items and one chosen item per duplicate group are importable; extra selected duplicates are deselected.
Ready items are auto-selected; unmatched and existing items are disabled and unselected.
The Import button is disabled when nothing importable is selected or a lookup is running.
The Metadata Settings button is disabled (with a tooltip) once any item has been searched or while a lookup runs.
A folder is auto-matched to the first lookup result only when not editing, no series is selected yet, and the query equals the folder name.
Lookup search input is debounced by 300 ms and the lookup runs only for a non-empty term, when it is the current queue item.
New items default to season type 'official' and the current default options; if the selected season type is not offered by the series, it resets to 'official'.
Each imported series is sent as monitored, monitor new items 'all', no tags, with no search for missing or cutoff-unmet episodes; the same TVDB id is sent only once.
If the default quality profile is unset or not found, it is set to the first quality profile.

shows.text: The page is titled "Import Series" under the "Media" scope heading.
While root folders are first loading, a loading indicator is shown.
If root folders fail to load, a danger alert with the root-folders load error message is shown.
If the root folder has no unmapped folders, an info alert says all series in the root folder path have been imported.
When unmapped folders exist, they are listed as one card per folder, and a footer is shown.
Each card shows a select checkbox, a poster (or a "?" placeholder), the folder name or matched series title, and the folder path or relative path.
Cards that are existing, unmatched or unresolved duplicates show a status label: "Already in library", "Pending" or "Duplicate match".
Ready cards show per-folder selects: Monitor, Quality Profile, Series Type, Season Type, Metadata Language and Season Folder (Yes/No), disabled until a series is matched.
The footer shows a Defaults bar with Monitor, Quality Profile, Series Type, Metadata Language and Season Folder selects.
The footer shows a select-all checkbox, a selected-of-total count, a Ready count, a Pending count (when non-zero) and an Already in library count (when non-zero).
The footer has a Compact Rows checkbox.
If an import fails, a warning icon opens a popover titled "Import Errors" listing the error messages.
The series match control shows a search field with a loading indicator while looking up, or a warning icon (no match found, existing, or error message).
Lookup results list the series title, year and network with a link to TheTVDB.

sideEffects.text: After a successful import, root folder data is invalidated, the new series are appended to the cached series list, and imported folders are removed from the page.
Leaving the page or changing the root folder clears all import items.
Saving the metadata settings modal sends a PUT of the metadata source settings and closes the modal on success.
The page loads root folders from the root folder endpoint.
